findings.one_line: The reproduced projection comparison uses only the X-marginal bounds (plus bounded DCT coordinates and the source/box constraints); neither p_W lower nor p_W upper is consumed, so this headline uniform bound is stated over a gratuitously narrower class.

Its total-error proof is solely the finite-sample projection event; neither side of the polynomial link condition is used, so the claimed upper bound can be stated for the broader balanced-marginal class rather than treating link structure as necessary.
